title: TagDuel lobby atomic lock and consent invariants
scenarios: SQLite fault injection before host-lock insertion proves a failed createTagLobby rolls back the session row and leaves no orphan lock.
SQLite fault injection before the accepted-members update proves acceptTag rolls back the invitee lock and accepted flag together.
Two lobbies may invite the same unaccepted member; only the first accepted lobby acquires the unique participant lock. Cancelling it releases the lock, allowing acceptance in the second lobby.
invariants: tag_members.owner remains unique across active sessions.
Lobby row, revision, accepted flag and lock insertion commit or roll back atomically.
Cancellation releases host and accepted participant locks.
Player balances, starter grants and card collection remain unchanged.
All tests use an isolated temporary SQLite database.
limits: This is a storage/TagStore integration test, not a live Discord API session.
No runtime files, resolver, catalog manifest, allowlist or persistent player data are modified.
The three cases do not certify any new card behavior.
command: npm run check && npm run build && node --test tests/tagLobbyAtomicLocks2v2.test.cjs
